summary: Creative Realities, Inc. filed a 424B5 preliminary prospectus supplement for an underwritten public offering of common stock and pre-funded warrants. The offering size and price are not yet fixed; the last sale price was $4.10 per share. Pre-funded warrants are exercisable at $0.01 per share with an ownership limitation and no expiration. The company notes a one-third market value limitation under Form S-3 I.B.6. Underwriter compensation, a 30-day greenshoe option, and director/officer interest up to $850,000 are disclosed. This is a routine capital raise, not a special situation. Watch pricing and any subsequent at-the-market sales.
